# 74240 - Octal buffer and line driver with 3-state outputs, inverting

Package DIP-20 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74240.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74240.json)

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1G | enable | low |  | controls pins 18, 16, 14, 12; when not enabled: float; channel 1 output enable; high puts 1Y1-1Y4 in the high-impedance state |
| 2 | 1A1 | input |  |  | Schmitt-trigger input (hysteresis 0.2 V min, 0.4 V typ) |
| 3 | 2Y4 | output |  | three-state |  |
| 4 | 1A2 | input |  |  | Schmitt-trigger input (hysteresis 0.2 V min, 0.4 V typ) |
| 5 | 2Y3 | output |  | three-state |  |
| 6 | 1A3 | input |  |  | Schmitt-trigger input (hysteresis 0.2 V min, 0.4 V typ) |
| 7 | 2Y2 | output |  | three-state |  |
| 8 | 1A4 | input |  |  | Schmitt-trigger input (hysteresis 0.2 V min, 0.4 V typ) |
| 9 | 2Y1 | output |  | three-state |  |
| 10 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 11 | 2A1 | input |  |  | Schmitt-trigger input (hysteresis 0.2 V min, 0.4 V typ) |
| 12 | 1Y4 | output |  | three-state |  |
| 13 | 2A2 | input |  |  | Schmitt-trigger input (hysteresis 0.2 V min, 0.4 V typ) |
| 14 | 1Y3 | output |  | three-state |  |
| 15 | 2A3 | input |  |  | Schmitt-trigger input (hysteresis 0.2 V min, 0.4 V typ) |
| 16 | 1Y2 | output |  | three-state |  |
| 17 | 2A4 | input |  |  | Schmitt-trigger input (hysteresis 0.2 V min, 0.4 V typ) |
| 18 | 1Y1 | output |  | three-state |  |
| 19 | 2G | enable | low |  | controls pins 9, 7, 5, 3; when not enabled: float; channel 2 output enable; high puts 2Y1-2Y4 in the high-impedance state |
| 20 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 18 | 1Y1 = 1G' ? NOT 1A1 : Z | the inverse of 1A1 while 1G is low; high impedance while 1G is high. |
| 16 | 1Y2 = 1G' ? NOT 1A2 : Z | the inverse of 1A2 while 1G is low; high impedance while 1G is high. |
| 14 | 1Y3 = 1G' ? NOT 1A3 : Z | the inverse of 1A3 while 1G is low; high impedance while 1G is high. |
| 12 | 1Y4 = 1G' ? NOT 1A4 : Z | the inverse of 1A4 while 1G is low; high impedance while 1G is high. |
| 9 | 2Y1 = 2G' ? NOT 2A1 : Z | the inverse of 2A1 while 2G is low; high impedance while 2G is high. |
| 7 | 2Y2 = 2G' ? NOT 2A2 : Z | the inverse of 2A2 while 2G is low; high impedance while 2G is high. |
| 5 | 2Y3 = 2G' ? NOT 2A3 : Z | the inverse of 2A3 while 2G is low; high impedance while 2G is high. |
| 3 | 2Y4 = 2G' ? NOT 2A4 : Z | the inverse of 2A4 while 2G is low; high impedance while 2G is high. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 64 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -15 |
| outputMaxVoltageV | 5.5 |
| inputSchmitt | yes |
| notes | SN74S24x figures (page 4). SN74LS24x: IOL 24 mA, IOH -15 mA. Three-state outputs drive bus lines; can drive terminated lines down to 133 ohm (page 1). |

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | any Y | PLH | 4.5 | 7 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 90 ohm, CL 50 pF |
| A | any Y | PHL | 4.5 | 7 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 90 ohm, CL 50 pF |
| G | any Y | PZL | 10 | 15 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 90 ohm, CL 50 pF |
| G | any Y | PZH | 6.5 | 10 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 90 ohm, CL 50 pF |
| G | any Y | PLZ | 10 | 15 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 90 ohm, CL 5 pF |
| G | any Y | PHZ | 6 | 9 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 90 ohm, CL 5 pF |

## Notes

Timing is the SN74S24x table (page 6); the SN74LS24x is slower (tPLH 9/14 ns for the 'LS240, 12/18 ns for the 'LS244, enable times up to 30 ns). The card uses both 74S and 74LS parts of this type.

## Sources

- [TI SN74LS240/SN74S240/SN74LS244/SN74S244 datasheet SDLS144D (April 1985, revised October 2016)](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74s240.pdf) - 1, 3, 4, 5, 6; SN74S240
